about.title: I understand the code and the business.
about.p1: For three years I was a software & infrastructure engineer in Unit 81, running production systems. I also served as a course instructor and commander — designing a software curriculum and mentoring junior engineers.
about.p2: Today I’m co-founding ReySecurity while studying Economics & Entrepreneurship (Data Science track) at Reichman University.
about.p3: So I build what your startup actually needs — not over-engineered infrastructure.
